narration:
The waker returned a false RIG STALL. `rig-health.sh` excludes the lane games under `D:\KenshiInst\*` when it checks for Kenshi, so with all three 5090 lane games running it read "Kenshi gone". All three are actually up (i3, i4 and i5). I fixed it so lane games count as BUSY, and `rig-health.sh` now returns `RIG BUSY kenshi=lanes(3)` with exit 0 (commit `2e08605`, pushed). I also restarted the waker.
